evals.name: florist-packet-after-entourage-add
evals.prompt: We just added one more pair of Principal Sponsors to Mariel & Joaquin's wedding (event_id evt_2026_dela_cruz_santos, file is at sample_event.json). They are 'Atty. Margarita Borja' (Ninang, bride side) and 'Mr. Felix Borja' (Ninong, bride side). Generate the updated packet for our florist Dahon Florals (vendor_id v_dahon_florals) so they can adjust the corsage/boutonniere count. Also tell me what other vendors are affected by this change and draft the short message we should send each one.
evals.expected_output: An updated florist packet (markdown) with the new corsage/boutonniere counts reflecting 7 PS pairs (was 3), plus a list of other affected vendors (photographer, videographer, host) with short Setnayan-voice change messages for each. Should NOT include dietary info, full guest list, or shot list in the florist packet.

evals.name: ceremony-time-shift-propagation
evals.prompt: The parish at Santuario de San Antonio just confirmed our ceremony slot has to move 30 minutes earlier — so 15:30 instead of 16:00 for Mariel & Joaquin's wedding (sample_event.json). Walk me through which vendors need to know, what specifically each of them needs to do, and produce the per-vendor change messages I can send via Viber. Keep messages in Setnayan voice.
evals.expected_output: A list of affected vendors (photographer, videographer, florist, hmua, host at minimum — caterer and band/dj less affected since reception time hasn't moved), with per-vendor messages explaining the shift and its specific impact on each (call time, setup window, etc.). Messages should sound warm and Filipino-comfortable, not corporate. Should explicitly note which vendors are NOT affected and why.

evals.name: design-vendor-intake-form
evals.prompt: We're building the V2 vendor onboarding flow for Setnayan. Design the data model and intake form for a NEW vendor type that's not yet in our system: 'Mobile Bar / Bartender' for Filipino weddings. They need to be able to receive packets from us. Specify what fields go in their packet, what changes should trigger a notification to them, and how their data integrates with the existing event JSON. Show your reasoning grounded in the existing sync matrix patterns.
evals.expected_output: A clear specification including: (1) reads list (what they see in their packet), (2) writes list (what they contribute back), (3) sync triggers (which event field changes notify them), (4) blocked fields (privacy), (5) suggested intake form fields, (6) JSON shape additions to sample_event.json. Should reference and align with the existing sync-matrix.md patterns.
